The '''Gargolyn system''' was a planetary [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It contained the planet [[Gargolyn IV]], which was home to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Cor]].<ref name="SWGS" />
